consensus_points.headline: HTTP mode never appends the accepted/routing_failed/agent_invocation_failed outcome to the delivery log; it only reads the startup snapshot. Dedup therefore resets on restart and first deliveries are not durable.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Append delivery outcome atomically before returning accepted/routing-failed, reload or lock the log per request, and add a redelivery-after-restart regression test.

consensus_points.headline: Secret loading is optional at startup. If the default `~/.openbao/...` file or `--secret-ref` resolution is missing, `from_paths_or_optional` retries with `secret_path: None`; then both simulated and HTTP paths skip HMAC verification whenever `skip_hmac` is f…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Fail startup/HTTP readiness when `--skip-hmac` is false and no secret is loaded. Keep local ergonomics by requiring explicit `--skip-hmac` for dev, and print the resolved secret source or exact missing path in the startup log.

consensus_points.headline: The user-facing output says `accepted: routed to <agent>` but the app only returns a route decision; it does not append a delivery-log row or create a durable invocation request. For operators, this is a silent mismatch: the surface reads like work was handed…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Change the wave-A message to `accepted: route resolved; invocation not yet emitted` or emit a durable dispatch-request/delivery-log row. Add `agent_invocation_failed` evidence when dispatch cannot happen so retries and rollback are understandable.

consensus_points.headline: HMAC verification is fail-open when no secret is loaded. Both the HTTP handler and simulated dispatch only verify when `!skip_hmac` and `Some(secret)` are true; if the SecretReference/file fallback is missing, unsigned GitHub webhook payloads are accepted unl…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Make missing secret a startup/configuration error whenever skip_hmac is false. Add tests for HTTP and simulate modes proving missing secret + skip_hmac=false rejects, while missing secret + explicit skip_hmac=true remains local-test-only and visibly logged.

consensus_points.headline: HTTP mode checks the in-memory delivery log snapshot but never appends accepted, routing_failed, agent_invocation_failed, or deduplicated outcomes back to the canonical delivery log. Dedup state therefore resets on process restart and first deliveries are not…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Append each delivery outcome atomically before returning the HTTP response, reload or lock the log per request, and add a redelivery-after-restart regression test proving a repeated GitHub delivery is deduplicated after process restart.

consensus_points.headline: HMAC verification only runs when a secret is present, and startup retries without the secret when the secret file is missing. A production misconfiguration therefore accepts unsigned webhooks instead of failing closed.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Make a missing secret fatal unless an explicit local-only simulate/dev mode is active; in server mode require a loaded SecretReference and reject every delivery when the secret cannot be resolved.

consensus_points.headline: The receiver checks an in-memory delivery log but the HTTP path does not append accepted deliveries to durable storage. A repeated GitHub delivery ID remains first-delivery unless it was already in the startup log, so replay/dedup protection is not effective.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Atomically append the accepted/routing-failed outcome before returning success, fsync or transactional-write the delivery log, and add a regression proving a second delivery with the same ID is deduplicated after the first accepted request.

consensus_points.headline: HMAC verification is skipped whenever skip_hmac is false but no secret is loaded; startup also retries without the secret after SecretIo. A missing/misconfigured webhook secret therefore accepts unsigned production webhooks.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Make missing secret a startup error unless --skip-hmac is explicitly set, and add tests for HTTP mode rejecting unsigned deliveries when the secret path/ref is absent.

consensus_points.headline: M-CC-P11-IP-003 acceptance requires the HTTP receiver to dedup against an append-only delivery log and route deliveries, but the HTTP path only reads the startup log and returns accepted/routing-failed without appending a delivery outcome. Operators cannot ad…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Append each HTTP delivery outcome atomically to `registry/vcs/webhook-delivery-log.json` before returning, add restart/redelivery tests, and make PR #7 evidence distinguish simulate-only behavior from live HTTP behavior.

consensus_points.headline: `sref://openbao/...` is mapped to `$HOME/.openbao/...` by a local resolver while comments say production should use OpenBao. This is a compatibility shim, not a real SecretReference adapter.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Wire the real OpenBao SecretReference resolver before production and clearly mark the file resolver local-only in config/ADR.
